name: @asra/props-manager
description: A structured property management library that provides API-based control over prop components, separate from the scene tree.
author: Asa Tsai

scripts.test: yarn has:test && vitest || echo 'No test files found. Skipping test.'
scripts.test:local: yarn has:test && vitest run || echo 'No test files found. Skipping test:local.'
scripts.test:ci: yarn has:test && vitest run --coverage --reporter=default --reporter=junit || echo 'No test files found. Skipping test:ci.'
